## Group-difference tests (feature vs crop label)
H0: the crop groups do not differ on the feature. H1: at least one group differs.
p-values are Holm-adjusted across the seven features within each test family.

Assumptions and cautions: ANOVA assumes roughly normal groups with similar variances (a small Levene p suggests unequal variances, so lean on Kruskal-Wallis). With large samples almost any difference is 'significant', so look at the effect sizes. This dataset is observational or synthetic, so these tests do not establish what causes a crop to grow.
